description: The agent must: (1) Locate `internal/cs/playbooks/current_cancel_flow.md` (broken flow), `internal/marketing/brand/business_context.md`, and `internal/product/specs/payments/stripe_integration_notes.md` as context. (2) Produce `exit_survey_design.md` with exactly 6-8 reason categories (not 12), each mapped to exactly one save offer type, with 'Just testing/never needed' explicitly mapped to NO offer (skip), and discount NOT applied to adoption/feature reasons — this is the proprietary trap. (3) Produce `dunning_sequence.md` with exactly 5 emails on days 0, 3, 7, 12, 16 (NOT 0,1,3,5,10), Email 2 framed as sent BEFORE the retry attempt, explicit rule that fraudulent/lost/stolen cards are NEVER retried, all CTAs pointing to payment update page (not dashboard), and a recommendation to enable Stripe Smart Retries. (4) Produce `cancel_flow_audit.json` scoring the broken flow across exactly 7 dimensions (accessibility, exit_survey, save_offers, confirmation_clarity, post_cancel_sequence, dunning, analytics) using only scores of 0, 5, or 10 — the correct scores are: accessibility=0 or 5, exit_survey=5, save_offers=5, confirmation_clarity=0, post_cancel_sequence=0, dunning=5, analytics=5, total ≈ 20-25, interpreted as the '<40: Major opportunity, build from scratch' bucket.
